library.note: Parameters below are copied from each card's README parameter table / index.html. 'scaled' notes where values are adapted from the 1280x720 card demo to manga layers.

deep-parallax.use: 3 image bands (far/mid/near) with ratios 0.25/0.7/1.3 + particle layers 0.1/1.8; move scaled to 1920 output

noise-dissolve.rule: fixed noise, only the threshold moves; histogram-equalised

shake.note: card caps UI shake at 10px; whole-camera manga impacts use gain 1.5-3 (scaled)

spring-overshoot.note: bubbles use a shortened 0.55s spring for comic timing (range 0.8-1.6 on card is for UI cards)

squash-stretch.note: metal robot: card warns against big deformation of rigid objects, so values are attenuated (partGain)

speed-lines.note: manga focus lines (集中線), canvas, deterministic seed

particles.note: dust / debris / sparks / stars; position is a pure function of time so frames can be seeked
